full_page.content:
1950, November 11
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of the handwritten message on a Seraphic Mass Association Certificate by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Mrs. Philomena Discenna, for speedy sight improvement, God willing - - -
Special (By request of) her Daughter Anne
November 11th, 1950
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M., Cap.
Original in possession of: Miss Lee Discenna 12281 Wilshire Ave. Detroit, MI 48213
